pages.text: $(bold)Dragon Staff$()$(br2)Obtaining: craft it at the $(bold)Tinker Station$() — a Dragon Soul Core + two Handles (the Dragon Soul Core is cast from Molten Dragon Soul Core).$(br2)Features: tame / reclaim / release the dragons of $(bold)Ice and Fire$(). Although it bears the same name as its earlier version, it should really be called the $(bold)Dragon-Subduing Staff$().

$(bold)Controls$():$(li)press the $(bold)bound key$() to use the taming skill (consumes 200 levels of experience) and begin taming wild dragons around you$(li)$(bold)Sneak + Right Click$() to switch between $(bold)Reclaim / Release$() modes$(li)in Reclaim mode, right-click a dragon to store it inside the staff (the slots increase as the staff levels up)$(li)in Release mode, right-click to release a tamed dragon in front of you$(br2)Once taming succeeds, the dragon is recorded in the staff, so you can carry it with you and release it in battle to fight by your side.
